'''Cuallas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked the [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] as a bartender during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
